attacker_is_unprivileged_contract.meaning: the attacker is an unprivileged plain contract requiring no special roles

balance_state_after_attack.meaning: value of the contract balance state variable after the attack

actual_eth_after_attack.meaning: actual ETH held by the contract (address(this).balance) after the attack

assumptions: The checked action is the reentrant withdraw sequence in StakingBase::_withdraw() described by the report.
balance and address(this).balance are both ETH-denominated amounts in wei.
The claim scope is the single selected impact contract_insolvency under the selected precondition attacker_unprivileged and intent intent_balance_equals_actual_eth.

unresolved.description: The report states the invariant and the post-attack inequality balance > actualETH but does not give a clean pre-action checkpoint value for balance and actual ETH; only the post-attack comparison is grounded.

limitations: The correspondence is formalized at the post-attack checkpoint because the report only supplies the post-attack inequality balance > actualETH.
Concrete wei values and the exact reentrancy call sequence are deferred to code binding.
